title: Cash-equivalent collateral list: approved liquid funds and ETFs (NSE Clearing)
when: Monthly (when NSE Clearing publishes the list)
purpose: NSE Clearing's published list of liquid mutual fund schemes and ETFs it accepts as cash-equivalent collateral. Ledgerline has no sample of this list yet: its columns are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when NSE Clearing's differs). Only the ISIN column is needed; a row whose type or category says non-cash is left out.
linked: Each load replaces the firm's cash-equivalent list: their pledged value goes in Finspot's Notional cash (RMS Limits column 25) and the risk screens' cash-equivalent collateral, besides government securities, T-bills and SDLs. The ISINs typed in Connections → Finspot uploads are added to it, and -ISIN there leaves one out.
source: No layout of NSE Clearing's cash-equivalent (approved liquid fund and ETF) list in the repository; the header texts are to confirm with a sample of the published list.
